findings.body: In `app/controllers/application_controller.rb`, the call to `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` assumes that the `ensure_loaded!` method exists on `I18n.fallbacks`. The new initializer defines a custom `FallbackLocaleList` class with an `ensure_loaded!` method, but it calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` inside it, which is not defined in the provided context. This could cause a NoMethodError at runtime if `I18n.ensure_loaded!` is not defined elsewhere.
findings.suggestion: Define `I18n.ensure_loaded!` method or modify `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` to call the correct method to load locales, possibly `I18n.backend.ensure_loaded!` or similar.
findings.title: Undefined method `I18n.ensure_loaded!` called from fallback locale list

findings.body: The removal of `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from all environment configuration files means that the fallback behavior for I18n is no longer enabled by default. This could cause missing translations to not fallback to the default locale or English, potentially breaking user experience in production and other environments. The new initializer sets a custom fallback list, but it does not explicitly enable fallbacks in the Rails config, which might be required for some I18n features to work correctly.
findings.suggestion: Re-enable `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` in the environment configs or ensure that the new fallback mechanism fully replaces the previous behavior and is compatible with Rails I18n fallback expectations.
findings.title: I18n fallbacks disabled in environment configs, may break translation fallback

findings.body: The `ensure_loaded!` method added to `I18n` singleton class in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` is defined but never called directly. The `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` which is defined here, but this method expects a locale argument, while the call in the initializer passes no arguments. This mismatch can cause runtime errors.
findings.suggestion: Change `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` to pass each locale to `I18n.ensure_loaded!(locale)` instead of calling `I18n.ensure_loaded!` with no arguments.
findings.title: Mismatch in `ensure_loaded!` method call arguments causes runtime error

models.summary: The change removes explicit enabling of I18n fallbacks in environment configs and introduces a custom fallback mechanism. However, the fallback enabling removal may break fallback behavior. Additionally, there are method definition and call mismatches around `ensure_loaded!` that can cause runtime errors. These issues need fixing to ensure reliable translation fallback and loading.
